control.name: CONTROL — a parse failure exits with the wrong code (usage exit 3 becomes 4)

mutations.name: help runs after the roster echo: the echo is called while the tree is built, so every help and version form reads configuration first
mutations.old: root := cli.NewRoot("cellctl", "start, stop and scaffold an Assay CELL on one laptop")
mutations.new:
root := cli.NewRoot("cellctl", "start, stop and scaffold an Assay CELL on one laptop")
	echoRoster()

mutations.name: version no longer exempt from the roster echo (the pre-run hook ignores the no-echo annotation)
a setting opens the config-map source nobody declared (the tick-budget binding gains Config)
mutations.new: func() cli.Binding { b := bStr("tick-budget", "per-pass tick budget (a duration)", "CELL_TICK_BUDGET"); b.Config = true; return b }(),

mutations.name: a setting reads an undeclared environment name (the model binding also consults ANTHROPIC_MODEL)
mutations.old: "model for THIS run only, passed through verbatim to the harness", "DESK_MODEL_OVERRIDE"),
mutations.new: "model for THIS run only, passed through verbatim to the harness", "DESK_MODEL_OVERRIDE", "ANTHROPIC_MODEL"),

mutations.name: one legacy flag form dropped (single-dash -model stops being accepted)
the-desk Opus refusal removed from the domain check (nothing below the adapter refuses; a parser-bypassing caller is admitted)
--set stops persisting (the cell.env write after a launch's overrides is dropped)
